headline: Tabcorp Shares Face Heavy Selling, Moving Negative YTD: What Happened? - The Bull
summary: Tabcorp shares suffered their worst one-day loss in years after Australia's financial crime regulator opened a formal enforcement investigation into its anti-money laundering controls. More than A$600 million was wiped from market value.
why: Tabcorp is an Australian gambling and wagering company, and regulatory enforcement action can lead to penalties and changes in its operations.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.
